Done. T4 solved on the first execution.

**What the script does** (`out/T4/solution.py`):

1. Reassembles the base from its two shards via `model.safetensors.index.json`; loads ft1/ft2 from their single files.
2. Verifies all three key sets are identical, that the base has 114 tensors, that the 48 expected MLP names are present, and that each of the 66 non-MLP tensors is bit-identical (`torch.equal`) in all three — every failure raises with the offending name.
3. Merges each MLP tensor as `base + 0.4*(ft1-base) + 0.4*(ft2-base)` in float32, always against the untouched base (results go into a separate output dict, never read back), and asserts exactly 48 were merged.
4. Writes `out/T4/model.safetensors` and re-opens it to confirm 114 tensors with the base's key set.

Report written to `out/T4/REPORT.md`.
